instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: If you visualize a room, you...
options: form a picture in your mind
options_en: form a picture in your mind
questions.explanation: To visualize is to form a mental picture of something you cannot see.
questions.explanation_ar: to visualize يعني تكوين صورة ذهنية لشيء لا تراه.

questions.question: A neutral colour is one that is...
questions.explanation: A neutral colour is muted and does not draw attention, unlike a bright one.
questions.explanation_ar: اللون المحايد هادئ ولا يجذب الانتباه، بعكس اللون الصارخ.

questions.question: Your primary residence is...
options: the home you mainly live in
options_en: the home you mainly live in
questions.explanation: Residence means the place where a person actually lives, and primary marks the main one.
questions.explanation_ar: residence تعني المكان الذي يعيش فيه الشخص فعلاً، و primary تحدد الرئيسي.

questions.question: Most people here tend to live in flats. Tend means...
questions.explanation: Tend to do means to be likely to do something as a usual pattern.
questions.explanation_ar: tend to do تعني أنه من المرجح فعل الشيء كعادة متكررة.

questions.question: To minimize noise is to...
options: reduce it as much as possible
increase it as much as possible
ignore it for a long time
options_en: reduce it as much as possible
increase it as much as possible
ignore it for a long time
questions.explanation: Minimize means to make something as small as possible.
questions.explanation_ar: to minimize يعني تقليل الشيء إلى أدنى حد ممكن.

questions.question: Two potential uses of the room are...
options: two costly ways to build it
two possible ways to use it
two finished ways to sell it
two hidden ways to lock it
options_en: two costly ways to build it
two possible ways to use it
two finished ways to sell it
two hidden ways to lock it
questions.explanation: Potential describes something possible in the future but not yet actual.
questions.explanation_ar: potential تصف شيئاً ممكناً في المستقبل لكنه غير واقع بعد.

questions.question: The magazine will feature famous homes. Feature here means...
options: show them as the main item
buy them at a low price
options_en: show them as the main item
buy them at a low price
questions.explanation: As a verb, feature means to present something as an important part of the content.
questions.explanation_ar: feature كفعل تعني تقديم شيء كجزء مهم من المحتوى.

questions.question: Learning a language can be mentally tiring. This means...
questions.explanation: Mentally refers to the mind, so the effort exhausts thinking rather than muscles.
questions.explanation_ar: mentally تشير إلى الذهن، فالجهد يتعب التفكير لا العضلات.

questions.question: Buying a house is a good investment. This means...
questions.explanation: An investment is money placed in something expected to gain value over time.
questions.explanation_ar: الاستثمار وضع المال في شيء يُتوقع أن تزيد قيمته مع الوقت.

questions.question: In theory, the trip takes twenty minutes. This means...
questions.explanation: In theory states what should happen ideally, and the sentence then contrasts reality.
questions.explanation_ar: in theory تعني ما يفترض حدوثه نظرياً، ثم تقابلها الجملة بالواقع.

questions.question: The only negative of the flat is no parking. Negative here is...
options: a bad point in a list
options_en: a bad point in a list
questions.explanation: Here negative is a noun meaning a disadvantage or unfavourable point.
questions.explanation_ar: negative هنا اسم يعني نقطة سلبية أو عيباً.

questions.question: To remove the books from the table is to...
questions.explanation: To remove means to take something away from its place.
questions.explanation_ar: to remove يعني إزالة الشيء من مكانه.
